counterfactual_missing_items: Negative for human herpesviruses 1 and 2, varicella-zoster virus, cytomegalovirus, adenovirus, and rubella virus
decisive_items: Positive for Chikungunya virus with weak viral load (detected by real-time PCR)
Stromal immune ring formation with underlying keratic precipitates
response.rationale: R6 is the champion because it combines the evidence of Chikungunya virus infection (R4) with the specific ocular manifestations (stromal immune ring formation and keratic precipitates) that are consistent with uveitis. R4 is the runner-up because it only accounts for the viral infection without considering the specific ocular complications.

rejected.why: Lacks evidence of Chikungunya virus infection
Too general, does not account for the viral etiology
Redundant with R3, does not add new information
